title: CLO 2025.0 - AI Model Pose Generator
description: The AI model pose generator eliminates the need for manual joint adjustments; simply input text prompts or upload images to easily create natural and expressive poses for fashion styling, clothing try-ons, and sports activities.
transcript:
This video introduces the AI model posture generator function for everyone.  
In the newly released 2025.0 version, we have launched a powerful new function, the AI model posture generator.  
This new function allows us to manually adjust the joints without any need to input text prompts or upload images.  
AI will be able to simply and quickly generate the model posture you want.  
First, select the virtual model, AI model posture generator in the menu bar.  
If there is a virtual model or costume in the 3D window of the software, a warning window will pop up.  
It will ask if you want to continue running the AI model posture generator.  
If you choose to run, all virtual models and costumes in the 3D window will be deleted.  
Before choosing to run, please save the current work content or open a new project file.  
In the AI model posture generator window, there are two methods to choose from: prompt words and images.  
When using prompt words, you can input the necessary description or select a keyword to generate images.  
When using images, you can upload the selected posture image file yourself and directly generate the posture according to the image.  
Next, let's take a look at how the AI model posture generator is operated.  
Let's take a look at how to use the prompt words.  
The first option is gender. You can choose between women or men according to your needs.  
Next is the keyword prompt.  
You can enter the description text you want to generate.  
On the right side of the prompt window, there are three different icons representing different functions.  
The first is the keyword suggestion.  
After clicking it, it will display the recommended list of keywords that we can use.  
When clicking one of the keywords, it will automatically be added to the prompt window and the keyword will be displayed in blue font.  
If you want to delete the keyword, you only need to click the X on the right side of the keyword under the prompt window.  
Or in the keyword suggestion, click the keyword again.  
You can cancel the selection of the selected keyword.  
Even if you use the same prompt, the AI model posture generator will generate different new images every time.  
But if you activate the second big arrow, which is the keyword function to keep the input, it will keep the image generated before as much as possible.  
At the same time, use the new keyword prompt to generate updates.  
The third type of arrow is random generation.  
When you want to find inspiration or ideas, you can use it.  
If you want to change the prompt, you can click the icon in the upper right corner of the prompt window, similar to an eraser, and clear the prompt to reset all the content.  
Or use the keyword function to keep the input.  
For the existing prompt, make detailed adjustments.  
After editing, click Start Generation.  
The AI model posture generator will create images based on the prompt.  
If you are satisfied with the generated image, please click Save.  
It can be exported as a posture file for further use.  
Now let's follow the example.  
Now let's create a new model posture according to the steps we just introduced.  
First, we will set the gender as male.  
Then, in the list of keywords recommended by the keyword prompt, select the keyword tennis.  
This means that we will eventually show the posture of a tennis player.  
Next, we will describe the complete text in detail.  
Enter "a tennis player's side wave" in the prompt box.  
Show the tension of speed and the player.  
Everything is ready.  
Click Start Generation to create the image.  
If you like the image generated, you can click Start Generation at the bottom.  
Apply the posture in the image as a virtual model posture.  
If you want to re-enter the description text in the prompt box, you can click Clear Prompt.  
If you just need to make some adjustments, you can open the keyword function to keep the input and then update the prompt.  
Click Start Generation.  
It will use the current image as the basis for the new image generated again.  
For example, we want to raise the arm on the basis of the current image.  
We first click the keyword to keep the input.  
Then, in the prompt box, add a new short phrase to modify the posture.  
"Raise the arm higher."  
For example, "raise your arm up."  
Once the final image is generated, it reflects the posture you want.  
Click Start Generation at the bottom of the window.  
Change the image posture to a virtual model posture.  
Click History Record on the right side of the window.  
You can check it out.  
You can check all the images generated in it.  
If there is an image you want to save in the history record, you can select it directly and then click Save in the upper right corner.  
Set up the save path.  
After clicking Save, a PNG image file will be saved.  
You can also select all the images and save all the images.  
Click Save after confirming there is no problem.  
The current posture will be translated into a posture file for further use.  
Now let's see how to use the existing image file to create a virtual model posture.  
We select a woman and then click the upload button.  
Select the image to be applied and click open.  
The image will be added.  
After successfully adding the image file, click Start Generation at the bottom of the window.  
Change the image to a model posture.  
After confirming that the generated posture is fine, click Save and save it as a posture file.  
Next, let's apply the saved posture file to the virtual model.  
Close the window of the AI model posture generator.  
You can import any female model from the library.  
Or open the project file you want to apply the posture to.  
Then click on the file to open the posture.  
Select the just saved posture file and open it.  
In the open posture window that is displayed,  
you can use the posture file after confirming that the virtual model has been applied.  
Use the AI model posture generator.  
All you need is a line of text or a reference image.  
The reference image can be easily created.  
It is a posture that is natural and expressive when used in fashion, clothing, and exercise.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - AI Model Pose Generator
chunks.content: ## Introduction to AI Model Posture Generator in CLO 2025.0 This section introduces the AI model posture generator feature in CLO 2025.0, which enables users to create and modify 3D virtual model postures quickly and intuitively. The tool eliminates the need for manual joint adjustments, text prompts, or image uploads by leveraging AI to generate desired postures efficiently. --- ## Accessing and Preparing to Use the AI Model Posture Generator Before running the AI model posture generator, users must be aware that any existing virtual models or costumes in the 3D window will be deleted upon activation. A warning prompts the user to save their current work or start a new project to avoid data loss. To begin, select the virtual model and then choose the "AI model posture generator" from the menu bar. The software supports two input methods for posture generation: prompt words (text descriptions) and images (uploading reference posture photos). --- ## Using Prompt Words for Posture Generation This section explains how to generate model postures using textual prompts and keyword inputs. - **Gender Selection:** Choose between male or female models as the base for posture generation. - **Keyword Prompt:** Enter descriptive text or select from suggested keywords to define the posture. - **Keyword Suggestions:** Clicking the keyword suggestion icon displays recommended keywords. Selecting a keyword adds it to the prompt with blue text. Clicking the "X" or re-clicking the keyword deselects it. - **Generation Variability:** The AI generates different images even with the same prompt unless the "keyword function to keep input" is activated, which retains previous image features while updating with new keywords. - **Random Generation:** A random icon provides new posture ideas for inspiration. - **Prompt Editing:** Use the eraser icon to clear and reset prompts or modify existing prompts while keeping input for refinement. - **Start Generation:** After setting the prompt, click "Start Generation" to create posture images. - **Saving Outputs:** Satisfactory images can be saved and exported as posture files for further use. --- ## Example: Creating a Tennis Player Posture Using Prompt Words Step-by-step operation to generate a specific posture: 1. Set gender to male. 2. Select the keyword "tennis" from suggestions. 3. Enter the detailed description: "a tennis player's side wave, showing tension and speed." 4. Click "Start Generation" to create the posture image. 5. If adjustments are needed, use the keyword keep input function to retain the current image and add new prompts such as "raise the arm higher." 6. Generate the updated image and save the posture file once the desired posture is achieved. --- ## Managing Generated Images and History Records The AI model posture generator maintains a history record of all generated images. Users can: - Review previously generated images. - Select individual images for saving as PNG files. - Save all generated images at once. - Export the current posture as a posture file for application on virtual models.

Users can: - Review previously generated images. - Select individual images for saving as PNG files. - Save all generated images at once. - Export the current posture as a posture file for application on virtual models. --- ## Generating Postures from Uploaded Images Users can upload existing posture images to generate corresponding virtual model postures: 1. Select the model gender (e.g., female). 2. Click the upload button and choose the reference image file. 3. Once uploaded, click "Start Generation" to convert the image into a 3D model posture. 4. Save the posture file after confirming the generated posture meets expectations. --- ## Applying Saved Posture Files to Virtual Models To use a saved posture file on a virtual model: 1. Close the AI model posture generator window. 2. Import or open the desired female or male model from the library or project file. 3. Open the saved posture file. 4. Use the applied posture on the virtual model within the CLO environment. --- ## Summary The AI model posture generator in CLO 2025.0 allows users to create natural and expressive poses for virtual models efficiently using either text prompts or reference images. It enhances workflows in fashion, clothing design, and exercise simulations by simplifying posture creation without manual joint adjustments. The tool supports detailed prompt editing, image history management, and easy application of saved postures to models.
